# Berlin Lease-End Checklist for a 2026-09-30 Move-Out
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

A practical renter checklist for closing out a 12-month Berlin tenancy. This is framed as preparation and documentation guidance, not a legal ruling.

## Move-Out Plan for a 2-Room Apartment
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

- **Notice timing:** Notice was given on **2026-06-25** for a **2026-09-30** move-out date, so keep a copy of the notice and proof it was delivered.
- **Final month focus:** Use September to finish repairs, collect records, and document the apartment condition room by room.
- **Professional cleaning fee:** Treat this as a point to verify against the lease, handover agreement, and any written house rules; keep all invoices or messages related to it.
- **Two-room inventory:** Make a simple room-by-room list for the living room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, hallway, and any balcony/storage area.

## Move-Out Preparation Checklist
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/check2-square.svg

- Confirm the **move-out date, handover time, and key return method** in writing.
- Read the lease for clauses on **renovation, cleaning, minor repairs, and deposit deductions**.
- Take **dated photos and videos** of every room after personal items are removed.
- Photograph **floors, walls, windows, fixtures, appliances, bathroom seals, sinks, and meters**.
- Save copies of **rent payments, utility settlements, communications, and any repair requests**.
- If you made repairs, keep **receipts, contractor invoices, and before/after photos**.
- Ask the landlord for a **written list of expected handover items** before the inspection.
- Prepare all keys: **apartment keys, mailbox keys, cellar keys, garage/access fobs, and copies** if any were issued.
- Clean the apartment to the level stated in the lease; if a professional cleaning fee is requested, ask for the **basis and invoice expectation in writing**.
- Remove all belongings, dispose of trash, and leave common areas tidy on the final day.

## Inspection and Handover Evidence
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clipboard-check.svg

- Bring a **printed or digital condition checklist** for each room.
- Walk through the apartment with the landlord and note **every visible issue immediately**.
- Record **meter readings** for electricity, water, gas, and heating if applicable.
- Take **timestamped photos** of the final condition during the handover.
- Ask for a **signed handover protocol** that lists:
  - date and time
  - key count returned
  - meter readings
  - existing damage
  - cleaning condition
  - any landlord reservations or comments
- Do not leave without a copy or photo of the signed protocol.
- If the landlord refuses to sign, note the refusal and keep your own written record with a witness if possible.

## Deposit Dispute Evidence File
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/folder2-open.svg

- Create one folder with subfolders for:
  - **Lease and addenda**
  - **Notice and delivery proof**
  - **Rent and deposit payments**
  - **Messages and emails**
  - **Photos and videos**
  - **Inspection protocol**
  - **Cleaning and repair receipts**
  - **Meter readings**
- Save files with clear names, for example:
  - `2026-06-25_notice_sent.pdf`
  - `2026-09-30_kitchen_before.jpg`
  - `2026-09-30_handover_protocol_signed.pdf`
- Keep **original files** and do not edit timestamps or metadata.
- Export a short **timeline document** with dates, what happened, and who said what.
- If there is a dispute over the cleaning fee or deposit deductions, keep a separate note with:
  - the amount claimed
  - the reason given
  - your response
  - the supporting evidence
- Back everything up in **two places**: cloud storage and a local drive.

## Deposit Dispute Readiness
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shield-check.svg

- Be ready to show that the apartment was returned in the condition required by the lease, minus normal wear and tear.
- Keep proof that you **delivered notice on 2026-06-25**.
- Keep proof of the **final condition on 2026-09-30**.
- If the landlord withholds part of the deposit, ask for a **written itemization** and supporting receipts.
- Respond in writing and attach your evidence in a clean, dated format.
- Stay factual: avoid emotional language and focus on dates, photos, receipts, and signed records.

## Quick Actions
- Action: [Button: Make evidence folder] https://www.google.com/drive/
- Action: [Button: Save handover template] https://www.tenantconsultation.com/
- Action: [Button: Check Berlin tenant info] https://www.berliner-mieterverein.de/

## Sources
- Berlin Tenants’ Association: https://www.berliner-mieterverein.de/
- German Civil Code overview: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/englisch_bgb/
- Consumer advice on renting: https://www.verbraucherzentrale.de/wissen/wohnen/miete-und-wohnen/
